item.title: Bose’s upgraded QuietComfort headphones add head-tracking immersive audio
item.summary: Bose announced a second-generation version of its entry-level QuietComfort noise-canceling headphones that were originally introduced in late 2023. The new headphones feature a refreshed design with a more comfortable headband that's easier to adjust and ANC that better adapts to changing noise environments.
